page: Microsoft Azure D128ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the Ddsv6 family, powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

For local storage, the D128ds_v6 includes 7559 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded and memory performance. It achieves a multi-core Geekbench score of 21171.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 105828.49, both placing in the top 10% tier. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, reaching 8837.3 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 511.08 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

The instance is optimized for data-intensive operations, as evidenced by its top-tier PassMark database operations score of 35291.08 and Redis SET throughput of 156.93 million operations per second. While single-core performance remains in the average tier with a stress-ng score of 1949.68, its massive parallel processing capabilities make it highly cost-efficient for multi-threaded workloads. The lack of a dedicated GPU limits its suitability for heavy deep learning training, but it remains capable for CPU-based LLM prompt processing, achieving 3355.11 tokens per second on a 135M model. This hardware profile is recommended for large-scale databases, high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and parallel data processing.
description: Microsoft Azure D128ds_v6 is a high-capacity, general-purpose virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM. Operating at 4.2 GHz, this instance features a 260 MB L3 cache and is backed by 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark data highlights its exceptional multi-threaded capabilities, with top-tier results in PassMark CPU testing, Redis SET operations at 156.93 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput of 171.91 GB/sec. While single-core performance is average, its massive memory bandwidth and high-density local storage offer excellent qualitative cost efficiency for resource-intensive parallel workloads. The D128ds_v6 is recommended for large-scale database hosting, multi-threaded software compilation, high-throughput web serving, and enterprise-level data processing.
